decisions.reason: The firm built a multi-model product line with its own page, has positive agency feedback, and the product fits its publicly announced compliance direction, so dropping it would write off a visible investment.
As the flagship shown on the home page and central to the announced agency-platform direction, the platform carries the heaviest investment and public commitment, making abandonment very unlikely.
